fields.name: lock
fields.meaning: the lock state, and whether a collector has marked or forwarded the object

fields.name: self_fwd
fields.meaning: set when a collector forwarded the object in place

fields.name: age
fields.meaning: how many collections the object has survived

fields.name: hash
fields.meaning: the identity hash, written the first time anything asks for it

fields.name: klass
fields.meaning: the compressed class pointer, present only when UseCompactObjectHeaders is on

lock_states.name: locked
lock_states.meaning: a stack lock is held, and the real header is in the lock record

lock_states.name: marked
lock_states.meaning: a collector is using the word, and the real header is elsewhere

note: The klass field is present only when UseCompactObjectHeaders is on, which is the default on 64 bit platforms from JDK 27. With the flag off, those 22 bits are unused in the mark word and the class pointer is a separate 4 byte field after it. The C++ oopDesc struct declares that field either way, so reading the struct alone will tell you the object has one when it does not.
